blocks.text: Data is the foundation of Data Science. Data is a collection of raw facts and values to produce information. It can be in the form of numbers, text, images, audio or video. Data is produced every day through different activities. Understanding data is important before analysis. Different types of data need different handling methods. Proper data understanding helps in obtaining correct results. Poor data understanding can lead to errors. Data must be accurate and reliable to produce accurate results

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Data quality strongly affects final results. Poor data can lead to incorrect conclusions.
Types of Data: Structured and Unstructured

Structured data is organized in a clear format, such as tables or spreadsheets. It has rows and columns that are easy to understand. Examples include students' mark sheets and databases. Unstructured data does not follow a fixed format (as shown in Figure 6.2). Examples include emails, images, audio, and videos. Unstructured data is difficult to analyze directly. Special tools are needed to process it. Both types of data are important. Modern systems use both structured and unstructured data.

blocks.text: Data Sources and Data Collection Methods

Data can be collected from many sources. Common sources include surveys, interviews, forms, sensors, and online platforms (such as blogs, social websites, and others). Manual data collection involves human effort, whereas automatic data collection uses machines and software. Data can be collected in real time or stored over time. The method depends on the purpose of the analysis. Good data sources and accurate data collections improve analysis quality.

Data storage refers to saving data for future use. Data can be stored in files, databases, or cloud systems. Proper storage helps protect data from loss. Data management involves organizing and maintaining data. It ensures data is easy to find and use. Security is an important part of data management. Backup systems help prevent data loss. Well-managed data improves efficiency. Data management supports long-term data use.

blocks.text: Proper understanding of data type is very important before analysis of data.
